entities.name: Janus
entities.description: Janus of the Synod, chief vedalken member of the Synod of Lumengrid and representative to Memnarch; killed by Glissa.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Elf who fought and killed Janus.

entities.name: Kane
entities.description: Viridian elf killed by Janus with a Disarm spell.

entities.name: Synod of Lumengrid
entities.description: Vedalken Synod on Mirrodin of which Janus was a chief member.

entities.name: Pool of Knowledge
entities.description: Place Glissa entered using Janus's fingers and where she killed him.

events.summary: Janus visited Glissa in the Tangle and was initially defeated by her; he killed Kane with a Disarm spell.
events.quote: He was initially defeated by Glissa as he visited her in the Tangle

events.summary: Glissa cut off two of Janus's fingers and later used them to gain access to the Pool of Knowledge.
events.quote: Glissa then cut off two of Janus's fingers.

events.summary: Glissa and Janus battled again at the Pool of Knowledge and Glissa killed Janus.

relations.quote: Janus was the vedalken's chief representative to their master

relations.note: Killed at the Pool of Knowledge

relations.quote: Janus killed Kane via a Disarm spell
Janus of the Synod was one of the chief members of the vedalken Synod of Lumengrid
